<thought>To find the template that matches the described Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons retrosynthetic step, I will search the template catalog for forward reactions that form a C‑C double bond and an aliphatic carboxylic acid, and that break a carbon‑phosphorus bond and a carbon‑oxygen bond. This should return the relevant template(s) with their IDs.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["C-P", "C-O"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bond", "aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "bonds_formed": null,
    "bonds_broken": null,
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
